reviews.comment: Genuinely funny and obviously loves his profession. His personal experiences as a political scientist play into the class frequently and make it more engaging. He's a huge college football fan, so this class is extra entertaining in the fall.

He's very nice but I did tend to find him hard to reach outside of class. Classic male prof tho and has dad humor. As far as his class goes though, He did Packback each week (dropping 3) and then we had 3 exams. Participation was done through QR code polls.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very likable and fun professor, assignments and readings were all relatively easy. Is very interactive everyday even with a large class

Quite honestly, a great professor! If I were to take this class again, I would have shown up to all the lectures. That's the biggest reason I have a B instead of an A. Really interesting to listen to and engaging with a lot of graphs and interesting slide shows.

Dr. Goidel is a very fun professor! His lectures are very insightful and engaging, and he encourages input and discussion. Exams are taken on a lockdown browser and cover lecture materials and readings. Dr. Goidel's lecture slides go over everything on the exams, and he posts the slides after the lectures. Great professor and awesome lectures!

extremely approachable and welcomes all perspectives in discussion. Much of the course was based off real time news events which made class applicable to real life. He brought us candy for halloween and truly cares about his students.
Phenomenal professor, lectures were interesting and funny, and he interacted with the class. He requires 2 short essays, and I believe 3 closed note test. Put in the work and you can get an A

Goidel's class covered a lot of topics, but he was thorough in explaining them. I also appreciated how the lectures aligned with the readings, because it made the tests a lot easier. The papers he assigned were also graded fairly and he responds fast to emails (unless a lot of students asked the same thing, then he answers in class or on Canvas).

He has a great personality and good sense of humor while lecturing. Sometimes he would start his lectures and I wouldn't know what to write or not write since he wasn't clear on what is pertinent to content from the readings. If you ask questions he will usually clear things up. Do not depend on email. Overall his lectures are very intriguing.

Goidel is one of the most respected POLS professors for a reason. While some of the class can be quite challenging, namely the amount of readings required, he is very passionate and I always looked forward to his class. 10% was in class polls (free pts.) 20% was packback (free pts.), 20% essays (2 750 word essays, easy), 50% Exams (2x25% & hard)

50% of the grade is based on two exams: a midterm and a final. It is largely based on the readings and you need to memorize author names. The grading of the final was extremely poor and grading is confusing and wishy-washy. Also extremely hard to contact outside of class, including his TA. Goes back on his word. Disappointed to say the least.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Goidel is an amazing professor! He cares about what he teaches and makes lectures engaging. I felt that this class was applicable to my day to day life and future career. He's understanding and wants to see his students succeed as lifelong learners.
SO GOOD! Very interesting and made class fun. Go to office hours to prepare for tests. He is so good at lecturing. Really enjoyed.

Kirby's passion about the topics he teaches comes through in his lectures and interactions with him. While this class is general and broad, he hits on the important sections of each very effectively. The lectures/readings were interesting and to the point. The tests were fair and assessed knowledge of the material. Great class.

Probably the best POLS professor I've had! Kirby really cares about making his class the best it can be. Lectures can get ramble-y but aren't boring and are very valuable. Just make sure you know the readings before exams (which are online) and do the quizzes and you'll be fine.

He can be funny and is a nice professor, but the organization of this class leaves a little bit to be desired. It's essentially two massive projects, and I felt like the grading criteria could have been more clear. The projects were also only tangentially related to the material in class, so I never felt like I was learning a ton.

I absolutely loved this prof! He was so funny and is always very attentive to anything the students have questions or need help with. Exams are pretty easy, answers are in the lectures and readings. There is a lot to read but the articles are very interesting. Almost one quiz a week, three exams that are multiple-choice/short answers. Take him!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: By far one of the most caring professors I've had. He really does enjoy his job and you can tell through his lectures. His lectures were super interesting, but you do have to pay attention to him because what he says is important for tests. A little difficult but not the hardest class I've taken.

Kirby was by far one of the best profs I've ever had! He always had very interesting topics to discuss in class and was always encouraged in class discussions. He does assign lots of readings from various media source outlets but they are really interesting pieces! Lots of assignments and quizzes to help improve your grade, definitely recommend!

Kirby is absolutely awesome, he is by far my favorite prof. Not only does he care about what he is teaching, but he also does it in a way that makes the material interesting. The work is fairly difficult, but the quizzes are online and he does allow some notes. 10/10 recommend if you actually want to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Goidel is a good professor in the sense he is very passionate about what he's teaching. This class is difficult in the manner he makes his own tests (graded by those HEAVILY) and doesn't provide a study guide. For an intro POLS, this is harder than all the 300 and 400s I have taken thus far.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Kirby is honestly the goat imo. The class was basically 2 massive papers (1015 pages SINGLE spaced) and 2 short ones, but they were extremely enjoyable to write as you can choose whatever you want. This guy will bend over backwards to help you and is incredibly nice. The big papers are a big help for future writing assignments and are great exp.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor you can tell was meant to teach. His goal is to teach and not to grade and you can automatically tell. He is such a passionate person, and if you don't understand something you can express that to him and he will break his back to help. Such a good person, glad I chose TAMU for people like him.

45% of our entire grade in 327 was due during FINALS week, a research essay that was 30% and a final essay that was 15% of out grade. And, he never let the class know our grades on those assignments. I think there was a class here that had potential, but I think all the students felt a bit burnt out and stressed because of this format.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader
